preconditions.description: The input is a list containing exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Both elements in the list are strings.

postconditions.description: The output list length equals the length of the longer input string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, str) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output is a string.
Each output row has exactly 3 characters (char, space, char).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][0] == strings[0][i] if i < len(strings[0]) else ' ' for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The first character of each row corresponds to the character at that index in the first string, or a space if the first string is shorter.
The middle character of each row is always a space.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][2] == strings[1][i] if i < len(strings[1]) else ' ' for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The third character of each row corresponds to the character at that index in the second string, or a space if the second string is shorter.
